verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm/HIP and Instinct documentation explicitly lists MI355X-class hardware as a supported target, with HIP programming model docs, ROCm library stack, container toolkit, Kubernetes GPU operator, and framework/inference support (vLLM, SGLang), confirming first-party toolchain support. Independent community benchmarking (chipsandcheese) further corroborates real-world use of the ROCm/HIP stack on this part, though some performance comparisons are debated. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer accounts of building/porting code specifically on MI355X, and clearer version-specific ROCm support-matrix confirmation for MI355X.
